description: Combine RCSB density-fit validation with the computed bond valence, occupancy, ligand count and solvent exposure for the three ion sites of 4CSH
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Values computed in this session (see provenance/lysk_chap_metal_analysis.py and the RCSB validation query)
df=pd.DataFrame([
 # ion, chain, RSCC, RSR, occupancy, BVS, expected valence, n protein ligands, SASA
 ("Ca2+","A",0.985,0.029,1.00,2.09,2,6,1.2),
 ("Ca2+","B",0.986,0.027,1.00,2.07,2,6,0.8),
 ("Ca2+","C",0.996,0.023,1.00,2.06,2,6,2.0),
 ("Ca2+","D",0.995,0.022,1.00,1.99,2,6,0.9),
 ("Zn2+","A",0.984,0.051,0.67,1.12,2,1,14.9),
 ("Zn2+","B",0.976,0.043,0.67,0.95,2,1,13.3),
 ("Zn2+","C",0.988,0.022,0.67,1.38,2,1,11.8),
 ("Zn2+","D",0.994,0.021,0.67,1.21,2,1,13.4),
 ("Na+","A",0.881,0.109,1.00,0.68,1,3,np.nan),
 ("Na+","B",0.901,0.094,1.00,0.93,1,3,np.nan),
 ("Na+","C",0.925,0.065,1.00,1.06,1,3,np.nan),
 ("Na+","D",0.867,0.158,1.00,0.94,1,3,np.nan),
], columns=["ion","chain","RSCC","RSR","occ","BVS","expected","n_prot_lig","SASA"])
df.to_csv("/tmp/t.csv",index=False)
print(df.groupby("ion")[["RSCC","RSR","occ","BVS","n_prot_lig","SASA"]].mean().round(3).to_string())

col={"Ca2+":"#2E7D32","Zn2+":"#C62828","Na+":"#9E9E9E"}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.4))

ax=axes[0]
for ion,g in df.groupby("ion"):
    ax.scatter(g.RSCC,g.BVS,s=110,color=col[ion],label=ion,edgecolor="k",linewidth=0.5)
ax.axhline(2.0,ls="--",c="#2E7D32",lw=1); ax.text(0.862,2.04,"expected BVS 2.0 for Zn(II) and Ca(II)",fontsize=8,color="#2E7D32")
ax.axhline(1.0,ls=":",c="#9E9E9E",lw=1); ax.text(0.862,1.04,"expected BVS 1.0 for Na(I)",fontsize=8,color="#666")
ax.set_xlabel("RSCC (real-space density fit, RCSB validation)"); ax.set_ylabel("bond valence sum")
ax.set_title("The Zn is well fitted to density\nyet chemically undersaturated"); ax.legend(frameon=False)

ax=axes[1]
for ion,g in df.groupby("ion"):
    ax.scatter(g.n_prot_lig,g.occ,s=110,color=col[ion],label=ion,edgecolor="k",linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_xlabel("protein ligands within 3.2 A"); ax.set_ylabel("refined occupancy")
ax.set_xlim(0,7); ax.set_ylim(0.5,1.1)
ax.annotate("Zn: only ligand is\nthe catalytic Cys54 S",(1,0.67),xytext=(1.9,0.78),fontsize=8,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=0.8))
ax.annotate("Ca: D45, D47, Y49-O,\nH51-O, D56 (bidentate)",(6,1.0),xytext=(3.2,0.95),fontsize=8,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=0.8))
ax.set_title("Coordination completeness vs occupancy")

ax=axes[2]
g=df.dropna(subset=["SASA"])
for ion,gg in g.groupby("ion"):
    ax.scatter(gg.SASA,gg.BVS,s=110,color=col[ion],label=ion,edgecolor="k",linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_xlabel("solvent accessible surface area of the ion (A$^2$), waters removed")
ax.set_ylabel("bond valence sum")
ax.set_title("Buried and saturated (Ca) vs exposed\nand unsaturated (Zn) in the substrate groove")
plt.suptitle("LysK CHAP$_K$ 4CSH: the zinc is a real, well-ordered, partial-occupancy adduct on the catalytic thiolate, not a cofactor site",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
